title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Allowance Earned by an Automation Plan in Good Standing
content:
## Portfolio accounts Q&A

**What earns the allowance?** An allowance is earned against the clearance figure of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record by an owner whose building automation service plan at the agreement's building, held under the Building Automation Service Plans, is in good standing. Two readings decide it: whether that plan stands in active status, and whether it owes anything on its own balance.

**How much?**

| The building automation service plan at the agreement's building | Allowance earned |
|---|---|
| stands in active status and owes nothing on its own balance | the standing allowance, 150.00 USD |
| stands in active status and owes something on its own balance | the part standing allowance, 60.00 USD |
| the owner holds no building automation service plan in active status | no allowance |

**Which building?** The plan read is the one at the agreement's own building; the status and the balance are read from the owner's Building Automation Service Plans records.

**Where does the boundary fall?** A plan whose own balance stands at nothing or less owes nothing and earns 150.00 USD; a plan whose own balance stands above nothing owes something and earns 60.00 USD.

**Is the allowance taken more than once?** No; it is the single figure the reading selects, subtracted once from the total.
